license_or_terms: No LICENSE file in the bstabler/TransportationNetworks repository (GitHub reports license: null); the repository and per-city READMEs ask users to cite the original data providers. Treat as freely redistributable research data with attribution.
weight_semantics: link length as distributed in the TNTP `length` column (MILES -- the in-file ORIGINAL HEADER reads 'length (miles)')
preprocessing: TNTP header declares 933 nodes, 2950 directed links, 387 traffic analysis zones. The published network was kept intact -- the zone-centroid nodes (ids 1..387) and their artificial centroid-connector links were NOT removed. The `length` column is strictly positive on every link in this file (the `free_flow_time` column is not, which is why length was used). Source is DIRECTED: symmetrised by keeping the MINIMUM length among the directed arcs joining a node pair (1475 arcs collapsed into an existing pair); 0 self-loops removed. No unit conversion. Aggregated 'sketch planning' network of the Chicago region (Eash et al. 1983). Graph before LCC extraction: 933 nodes, 1475 edges, 1 connected component(s); kept the largest (933 nodes). Node ids relabelled 0..n-1 in sorted order of the original labels.
name: chicago-sketch-road
